title: Air Ticket Fare Brands: Travel Credit Vouchers against a Given-Up Ticket
content:
Where a traveller has given up an air ticket sold under the Air Ticket Fare Brands, the booking may carry a travel credit in place of what was bought. The desk issues a travel credit voucher in the traveller's name against that booking, and the traveller holds a voucher code they can quote.

**When the value is fixed.** The value placed on the voucher is fixed only after the cancellation penalty owed under the fare brand held stands as a withheld line on the booking. Until that withheld line stands on the booking, the value placed on the voucher is not fixed.

**A further condition of the same kind.** The value placed on the voucher is fixed only after the taxes and carrier fees the airline returns stand as a payout line on the booking. Until that payout line stands on the booking, the value placed on the voucher is not fixed.

**Situation of use, and what the instrument does.** One call mints one voucher and posts the matching issue line to that booking's credit ledger, so the booking afterwards carries an open travel credit of the value named, redeemable until the last date given.

**How it is invoked.** The desk unlocks the instrument `issue_travel_credit_voucher_dd7ecc26` and then calls it, one call minting one voucher.

**What it is given.**

- `air_booking_id`: an identifier, the reference number of the air booking whose ticket produced the voucher, as returned by the air booking lookup for this traveller.
- `source_event_id`: an identifier, the reference number of the original fare line on the same booking whose value the voucher replaces, as returned by the air booking event lookup.
- `passenger_sequence`: a fixed format, which traveller on the booking the voucher is issued for, in ticket order, written as a whole number starting at 1; no empty value and no rounding, the position being counted exactly.
- `credit_expires_on`: a fixed format, the last date the voucher may be redeemed, written as a calendar date in the form YYYY-MM-DD in the traveller's own local calendar, with no time part and no empty value, every voucher carrying a last date.
- `voucher_value_usd`: a fixed format, the value placed on the voucher, a positive US dollar amount with 2 decimal places, given to the cent exactly as the published terms produce it; US dollars only, and no empty value.

**What comes back.** A confirmation sentence in plain text, naming the voucher code minted (a string beginning WLTC), the reference of the new issue line (a string beginning "acrd_"), the air booking reference the line was posted to, the value placed on the voucher in US dollars to two decimal places, and the last date it may be redeemed. Receiving that sentence means the voucher now stands open in the traveller's name.
